integration_notes: The canonical public boundary remains international_coverage_audit.py; engine and ISO data are internal small modules, not alternate runtimes.
The auditor imports existing market/source/shared-family registries and performs no network I/O.
Path provenance uses contiguous exact slug segments: AUT cannot match auth_* and BASE cannot match database.
Test files are excluded from code/runtime provenance.
TED_EFORMS membership is projected only through the concrete active TED registry source; strategic shared families without a concrete active source are not promoted to executable coverage.
BUILD/SHARED markets without an active production source receive NO_ACTIVE_PRODUCTION_SOURCE and a matching missing-integration entry.
The dedicated workflow generates deterministic JSON and Markdown artifacts and validates their contract.
No country/source state, runtime registry, production deployment, or Master Queue item is modified.

rollback: Revert PR #192, or delete all files listed in files_added. No pre-existing global registry/runtime file requires restoration.
